title: Fine log enhancement of a fixed scheme over a log base
statement:
Let $(S,M_S)$ be a fine log scheme [def-trf-fine-log-scheme-morphisms], let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and fix a scheme map $f:X\to S$. Let $\{p_a:V_a\to X\}_{a\in A}$ be a jointly surjective etale covering [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. For each $a$ let $V_a$ be locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], equipped with a fine log structure $M_a$ (etale-local charts by finitely generated integral monoids) and a log morphism $f_a:(V_a,M_a)\to(S,M_S)$ whose underlying map is $fp_a$. Log structures, their structure maps $\alpha_a:M_a\to\mathcal O_{V_a}$, and log morphisms have the meaning of [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]; no saturation is assumed. On $V_{ab}=V_a\times_XV_b$ [def-pc-fibre-product] suppose given isomorphisms $\phi_{ab}:M_a|_{V_{ab}}\xrightarrow{\sim}M_b|_{V_{ab}}$ over $\mathcal O_{V_{ab}}$, with identity on the diagonals and $\phi_{bc}\phi_{ab}=\phi_{ac}$ on triple overlaps. Assume $\phi_{ab}f_a^\flat=f_b^\flat$ on $V_{ab}$, using the common inverse image of $M_S$ along $fp_a\mathrm{pr}_1=fp_b\mathrm{pr}_2$. Restriction means localization of the small etale site, so these are isomorphisms of log structures on the actual scheme overlaps.

Then $X$ is locally Noetherian, and there exist a fine log structure $M_X$ on $X$, isomorphisms $e_a:M_X|_{V_a}\xrightarrow{\sim}M_a$ with $\phi_{ab}e_a=e_b$ on overlaps, and a log morphism $F:(X,M_X)\to(S,M_S)$ whose underlying map is $f$ and whose restrictions through $e_a$ are $f_a$. The structure morphism of this lift is a homomorphism $F^\flat:f^{-1}M_S\to M_X$ over $\mathcal O_X$. If every $M_a$ has etale-local charts by fine saturated monoids, then $M_X$ has such charts. Here the underlying scheme $X$ and map $f$ are prescribed; no assertion of effective descent of schemes or of line bundles is made.

source.place: Expose VI 1.1, printed p.69 (etale fine/fs charts and locally Noetherian convention); VIII 3.3.4(ii) and 3.3.8, printed pp.107--108 (strict etale chart descent). Underlying local Noetherianity: Stacks descent.tex Tag 034C, lemma-Noetherian-local-fppf. This is the fixed-underlying-scheme and relative-log-map part of that descent argument.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-etale-local-noetherian-descent] to the prescribed scheme $X$ and its jointly surjective etale covering $\{p_a:V_a\to X\}$. Each $V_a$ is locally Noetherian by hypothesis, so $X$ is locally Noetherian. This supplies the underlying-scheme hypothesis for fine log structures before any log descent is invoked.

source.place: Tag 034C, lemma-Noetherian-local-fppf, descent direction specialized to an etale covering

proof.text: Apply the existence clause of [lem-trf-fine-log-structure-etale-descent] with $T=X$, $T_a=V_a$, local log structures $M_a$, and transitions $\phi_{ab}$. Step 1 supplies local Noetherianity; the given transitions commute with the structure maps, are identities on diagonals, and satisfy the required cocycle. Obtain a fine log structure $(M_X,\alpha_X)$ and structure-preserving monoid isomorphisms $e_a:M_X|_{V_a}\xrightarrow{\sim}M_a$ with $e_b=\phi_{ab}e_a$. If all local structures have fine saturated charts, the same cited statement supplies fine saturated charts for $M_X$.

source.place: Expose VI 1.1, printed p.69; VIII 3.3.4(ii) and 3.3.8, printed p.107, strict etale chart descent

proof.text: Work directly with the relative-test presentation of [def-trf-fine-log-scheme-morphisms]. On a test object V with a lift g to U_a, transport the given section homomorphism by e_a^{-1}. Naturality of e and localMap makes these homomorphisms natural under test-object restriction. Their values agree for different lifts by e_b=phi_ab e_a and the hypothesis phi_ab localMap_a=localMap_b. For every V, the sieve of arrows j:Z→V whose source admits a lift to some U_a is covering: it contains the base changes V×_X U_a→V. The sheaf axiom of [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], implemented by Presheaf.IsSheaf.amalgamate in CommMonCat, glues the compatible transported section homomorphisms for each relative diagram (W,V,k). Separatedness of the monoid sheaf proves naturality in both W and V, using naturality of localMap after restriction. Separatedness of the multiplicative structure sheaf proves compatibility with alpha, using e.alpha and localMap.compatibility. This constructs the HomAlong map without constructing an inverse-image sheaf or invoking the separate morphism-gluing clause of the fine-log descent theorem.

source.place: Tag 04TQ, lemma-glue-maps, sectionwise gluing and separatedness; Tag 00VM, definition-sheaf-sets. Relative-test presentation: ILO VI 1.1.

proof.text: By the definition of a log morphism [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], the pair $F=(f,u)$ is a log morphism $(X,M_X)\to(S,M_S)$ with $F^\flat=u$. For every $a$, $e_a(u|_{V_a})=e_au_a=f_a^\flat$, and its underlying scheme map on $V_a$ is $fp_a$. Thus its restriction through $e_a$ is exactly $f_a$. The isomorphism compatibility and the conditional saturated-chart assertion are already established in Step 2.

source.place: Expose VI 1.1, printed p.69, log structures and log morphisms; assembly of the descended relative structure

lean.statement: theorem exists_fineLogStructure_fixedScheme_enhancement (S : FineLogScheme.{u}) (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ S.scheme) {ι : Type v} (U : ι → X.Etale) [∀ a : ι, IsLocallyNoetherian (U a).left] (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ (a : ι) (y : (U a).left), (U a).hom y = x) (D : FineLogEtaleDescentDatum U) (localMap : ∀ a : ι, (D.localLog a).HomAlong S.logStructure ((U a).hom ≫ f)) (hover : ∀ (a b : ι) (V : X.Etale) (g : V ⟶ U a) (h : V ⟶ U b) (W : S.scheme.Etale) (k : V.left ⟶ W.left) (ha : k ≫ W.hom = g.left ≫ ((U a).hom ≫ f)) (hb : k ≫ W.hom = h.left ≫ ((U b).hom ≫ f)) (s : S.logStructure.monoidSheaf.obj.obj (op W)), D.transition a b V g h ((localMap a).sectionMap W ((Scheme.Etale.overToEtale (U a)).obj (Over.mk g)) k ha s) = (localMap b).sectionMap W ((Scheme.Etale.overToEtale (U b)).obj (Over.mk h)) k hb s) : IsLocallyNoetherian X ∧ ∃ (M : EtaleLogStructure X) (_hM : M.IsFine) (e : D.Gluing M) (F : M.HomAlong S.logStructure f), (∀ (a : ι) (V : X.Etale) (g : V ⟶ U a) (W : S.scheme.Etale) (k : V.left ⟶ W.left) (hk : k ≫ W.hom = V.hom ≫ f) (ha : k ≫ W.hom = g.left ≫ ((U a).hom ≫ f)) (s : S.logStructure.monoidSheaf.obj.obj (op W)), e.component a V g (F.sectionMap W V k hk s) = (localMap a).sectionMap W ((Scheme.Etale.overToEtale (U a)).obj (Over.mk g)) k ha s) ∧ ((∀ a : ι, (D.localLog a).IsFineSaturated) → M.IsFineSaturated)

Clause by clause: fine base S, prescribed X and f, pointwise jointly surjective étale cover U : ι → X.Etale (free universe v, may be empty), loc. Noeth. members, descent datum D, local maps HomAlong over (U a).hom ≫ f. hover is exactly φ_ab f_a^♭ = f_b^♭ on a common base section; testing only overToEtale objects is enough because overToEtale is an equivalence and sectionMap is natural. Conclusion: IsLocallyNoetherian X ∧ ∃ fine M, Gluing e, HomAlong F over f with e_a∘F^♭ = f_a^♭, and conditional fs. Nothing stronger assumed, no clause missing.
